name: Sennyuu Makino
source:
She is a blonde-haired, blue-eyed, busty maid with beautiful long sharp eyes.

She is a typical tsundere and acts as if she hates Shiki like a snake. She seems quiet and obedient to the outside world, as if she thinks she can't help it if she gets out of line.

She was raised well and can handle the housework in the mansion without difficulty, though not as well as Reize. She is patient when it comes to being abused, and can endure a great deal of pain even if it is inflicted on her.

She calls Reize by her first name, and struggles calling Shiki "master". She refers to her parents with "father and "mother".

[From [url=https://erectlip.amusecraft.com/product37/]official site[/url]]
